The Lymphatic Connection

A Drainage Network Most People Never Think About

Your lymphatic system is a network of vessels that clears excess fluid, waste, and toxins from your tissue — separate from your bloodstream and your kidneys. When it isn't draining efficiently, fluid can build up and settle in areas like the face, hands, belly, and ankles.

Frequently Asked Questions

Individual results vary. Many customers report noticing changes within the first few weeks of consistent daily use, though this is not guaranteed for everyone.
